chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from al-Husayn ibn Naeem al-Saffaf, who said:

I, Hisham ibn al-Hakam, and Ali ibn Yaqtin were in Baghdad. Ali ibn Yaqtin said: I was sitting with the Pious Servant (peace be upon him) when his son Ali entered. He said to me: O Ali ibn Yaqtin, this is Ali, the chief of my children. Indeed, I have bestowed upon him my kunya (agnomen). Hisham struck his forehead with his palm and said: Woe to you, how did you say that? Ali ibn Yaqtin replied: I heard it from him, by God, just as I said. Hisham said: The authority, by God, is for him after him.

key_terms.الْعَبْدُ الصَّالِحُ: The Pious Servant, a title for Imam Musa al-Kadhim
key_terms.هُشَامُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ: Hisham ibn al-Hakam, a prominent companion

ai.seo_question: How did Imam Musa al-Kadhim designate Imam Ali al-Ridha as his successor?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the explicit designation (*nass*) of Imam Ali al-Rida as successor by his father, Imam Musa al-Kadim, through the symbolic bestowal of the kunya 'Abul Hasan.' The presence of Hisham ibn al-Hakam, a key companion, and his subsequent affirmation that 'the matter is in him after him' underscores the Shia doctrine of *Ismah* and the continuity of authority within the Ahl al-Bayt, distinguishing it from the Sunni concept of election (*shura*).

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 11 - It is narrated from Muhammad bin Yahya from Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Isa from Hasan bin Mahbub from Husain bin Naeem Sahaf that he said:

I, Hisham bin Hakam and Ali bin Yaqtin were in Baghdad, when Ali bin Yaqtin said: I was with Abdus Salih [Imam Musa Kadhim (a.s)] when his son, Ali entered. Imam (a.s) said: O Ali bin Yaqtin, this Ali, is the chief of my children and I have given to him my agnomen (both were called Abul Hasan). [In another narration:] Hisham struck his face with the palm of his hand and said: Shame on you, how can you say that? ‘By God, I heard it from him, just as I said it,’ replied Ali bin Yaqtin. ‘Then, by God, the authority is for him after (Musa),’ said Hisham.
